nodes.name: test_continuous_control.py
nodes.summary: Hardware-free regressions for local latest-target queues and legacy EtherCAT sessions. They exercise numeric validation, bounded PDO recovery, immediate retargeting, idle enable, cleanup, and accumulated travel across encoder rollovers.

nodes.name: QueueTests
nodes.summary: Validation and projection regressions for immutable latest-target MotionQueue commands, including finite positive profiles, atomic rejection, queue replacement, and closed sessions.

nodes.name: QueueTests.test_profile_has_no_software_upper_or_lower_range
nodes.summary: Accepts finite positive speed/acceleration profiles over very wide magnitudes and rejects zero, negative, boolean, nonfinite, and invalid values.

nodes.name: QueueTests.test_latest_relative_projection_and_atomic_rejection
nodes.summary: Checks readiness gating, immutable command targets, relative projection from planned targets, atomic invalid-command rejection, and single latest-slot replacement.

nodes.name: QueueTests.test_finiteness_latest_slot_and_closed_session
nodes.summary: Rejects malformed targets, verifies repeated relative updates occupy one slot, and ensures closed sessions reject further submission while fresh queues reset state.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests
nodes.summary: PDO recovery regressions using a fake master to ensure incomplete frames do not advance feedback or setpoint edges. They check bounded retries, cooperative stop, recovery timing, and alarm handling.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests.session
nodes.summary: Builds a fake legacy _Session with expected WKC and explicitly seeded axis outputs/feedback for focused PDO exchange tests.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests.test_transient_timeout_and_partial_wkc_retry_without_new_target_edge
nodes.summary: Injects incomplete PDO frames and verifies identical setpoints are retried once, partial feedback is discarded, and motion is not triggered twice.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests.test_persistent_wkc_failure_is_bounded
nodes.summary: Checks persistent receive failure stops within five exchanges and neither updates feedback nor reports successful recovery.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests.test_stop_prevents_retry_and_slow_recovery_still_stops
nodes.summary: Verifies stop requested during receive prevents another exchange and a recovery attempt exceeding the time budget still fails closed.

nodes.name: CommunicationTests.test_alarm_after_recovery_is_not_ignored
nodes.summary: Injects a transient transport failure followed by valid feedback carrying an alarm and verifies the recovered frame still faults the session.

nodes.name: SessionTests
nodes.summary: Persistent manual session regressions for native profile conversion, idle enable, immediate retargeting, fault cleanup, cancellation, and unwrapped multi-revolution feedback.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_transient_wkc_during_target_ack_continues_and_restores
nodes.summary: Checks a transient WKC failure during continuous acknowledgement recovers without duplicate targets and leaves the bus clean after stop.

nodes.name: SessionTests.assert_clean
nodes.summary: Asserts all drives are disabled, the master is closed, selected-axis parameters are restored, and unselected drives never receive motion targets.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_high_profile_and_tiny_positive_profile_use_native_parameters
nodes.summary: Verifies large and tiny finite positive motion profiles convert to native counts with a minimum value of one and restore correctly.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_native_overflow_rejected_before_parameter_writes_or_enable
nodes.summary: Injects native 32-bit profile overflows and verifies validation rejects them before drive writes or enable while closing the master.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_enable_holds_three_axes_and_idle_stays_enabled
nodes.summary: Verifies enabling holds captured positions, several absolute/relative targets execute with per-axis direction conversion, and an idle continuous session remains enabled until stop.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_stop_during_first_move_clears_later_commands
nodes.summary: Checks stopping during a started command clears later queued targets, prevents their execution, and restores the drives.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_updates_while_moving_without_waiting_for_arrival
nodes.summary: Emulates gradual motion and verifies immediate forward/reverse retargeting supersedes older commands without disabling or waiting for arrival.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_fault_and_ack_timeout_disable_and_restore
nodes.summary: Injects communication, path, enable-state, and acknowledgement faults and checks the continuous session disables and restores selected drives.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_pre_cancel_never_enables
nodes.summary: Verifies an already-set stop token prevents any motor target or enable-triggered movement and completes cancellation cleanup.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_unlimited_travel_and_feedback_across_multiple_encoder_rollovers
nodes.summary: Runs hundreds of relative commands across multiple signed encoder rollovers and verifies large positive/negative unwrapped feedback and final return to origin.

nodes.name: test_platform_control.py
nodes.summary: Shared fake EtherCAT slave/master and hardware-free regressions for the legacy three-axis UDP bridge and CiA402 session. Tests cover peer ownership, sequence validation, latched disable, watchdog faults, position wrapping, and parameter restoration.

nodes.name: FakeSlave
nodes.summary: Emulates supported SV635N identity, SDO parameters, PDO mappings, watchdog/DC registers, and CiA402 feedback. Setpoint rising edges update wrapped encoder positions and recorded targets without physical hardware.

nodes.name: FakeSlave.__init__
nodes.summary: Seeds supported identity, initial wrapped positions, native motion parameters, exact PDO maps, and saved originals for deterministic hardware-free tests.

nodes.name: FakeSlave.exchange
nodes.summary: Decodes output PDOs and emulates CiA402 state, acknowledgement, and arrival bits, applying a wrapped target only on a new-setpoint rising edge.

nodes.name: FakeMaster
nodes.summary: Minimal pysoem-compatible fake master holding four FakeSlave instances and expected WKC. It propagates bus states, exchanges simulated PDOs, and records close state for cleanup assertions.

nodes.name: InboxTests
nodes.summary: Legacy UDP mailbox and bridge regressions for ordering, target validation, session rejection, heartbeat expiry, first-peer ownership, and permanent disable.

nodes.name: InboxTests.test_validation_and_stale_session
nodes.summary: Rejects stale sessions and malformed, nonfinite, boolean, oversized, or out-of-bound three-axis targets without publishing a latest command.

nodes.name: InboxTests.test_udp_handshake_peer_and_fault
nodes.summary: Uses loopback sockets to verify hello establishes the peer, stranger commands are ignored, valid commands update the inbox, and invalid owned commands latch stop.

nodes.name: SessionTests
nodes.summary: Legacy three-axis and single-move regression suite verifying latched stop, watchdog faults, direction/wrapping, cleanup, and restoration with an emulated master.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_watchdog_wkc_and_limit_fail_closed
nodes.summary: Injects heartbeat expiry, WKC failure, configured travel violation, and local stop into the legacy three-axis session and verifies disable, restoration, and master close.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_persistent_motion_wrap_direction_stop_and_restore
nodes.summary: Verifies persistent three-axis targets honor per-axis direction and encoder wrapping, unchanged heartbeat targets do not restart motion, and stop restores parameters without intermediate disable cycles.

nodes.name: SessionTests.test_pre_cancel_never_enables
nodes.summary: Verifies an already-set stop token prevents any motor target or enable-triggered movement and completes cancellation cleanup.
